content.comment_body: Hi, I encountered the same issue when trying to send email using my [product_name] module. After multiple attempts, I was able to send an email with these settings: SMTP server: smtp.gmail.com, Port: 587, Encryption: STARTTLS (if possible), Own email and name: my Gmail address, Password: Gmail account password. For the CA certificate, I used 'Currently used file: No file loaded'. I did not change anything on my firewall and enabled 'Allow less secure applications' on my Google account. The email was sent to a test user I created with another email address and no phone number. It worked for me without a CA certificate, though I tried some certificates using OpenSSL. Best regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], please avoid posting the same problem in multiple topics. You’ve posted this in four threads – posting once is enough. Thanks.

This topic is closed because the question was posted more than once. The second thread titled 'Unable to connect on my [product_name] using OpenVPN' is published within the '[product_name] - Communication' section. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: The user explained their solution for configuring email sending on their [product_name] module using Gmail SMTP. They succeeded without a CA certificate after several tries, highlighting confusion around certificate usage and the need for trial-and-error due to unclear documentation on email setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward and reliable way to configure email on their [product_name] modules, with clear instructions regarding security certificates and required settings.
